lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A rectilinear grid of high-intensity circular spots arranged in approximately four primary horizontal rows and twelve visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits and anterior to the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-luminance blobs are positioned at the nexus of vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity and horizontal longitudinal alignments, forming a regular matrix.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp luminance gradient with high reflectance on the dorsal edge and deep shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance circular pixel clusters concentrated primarily on the lower half and anterior margin of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a large, dark-pigmented remora (Echeneidae) attached to the dorsal-posterior flank, and at least two smaller individuals visible in the ventral water column below the pectoral fin.
